name: com.boxqkrtm.ide.cursor
description: Cursor editor integration for supporting Cursor as code editor for unity. Adds support for generating csproj files for intellisense purposes, auto discovery of installations, etc.

_upm.changelog:
Integration:

- Always open Cursor on the project folder so Project Rules load; .code-workspace is now opt-in
- Recognize Cursor AppImage on Linux
- Respect Auto Refresh mode on save, including Play Mode

Project generation:

- Generate .slnx for SDK-style projects (needs .NET SDK 9.0.200+ in Cursor)
